name: cl_Cu38
title: Cu38 cluster
description: Gas-phase Cu38. For many-body potentials (Gupta, Sutton-Chen) the GM is the Oh fcc truncated octahedron, separated from icosahedral/decahedral structures as in the LJ38 double funnel (Doye & Wales, New J. Chem. 22, 733 (1998); Cambridge Cluster Database). NEP89 agrees; the best non-fcc structure found lies 0.11 eV higher.
